owner.label: Owner
owner.description: Full control, including other owners and deletion.

admin.label: Admin
admin.description: Manages members and settings, but not ownership.

member.label: Member
member.description: Access to the organization without administering it.

activity.daysAgo: {count, plural, one {# day ago} other {# days ago}}

invitationActions.renewedNotSent: The invitation was renewed but the email failed to send
invitationActions.withdrawDescription: The link sent to {email} stops working immediately. You can always invite them again.

self.title: Change your own role?
self.description: You will be {role, select, owner {owner} admin {admin} other {member}} in {organization} and lose the rights you have now. You will not be able to change it back yourself.

promote.title: Make {name} an owner?
promote.description: {name} will have full control of {organization}, including managing its owners and requesting its deletion.

demote.title: Remove {name} as owner?
demote.description: {name} will be {role, select, owner {owner} admin {admin} other {member}} and lose control of {organization}. You can make them an owner again.

roleChanged.self: You are now {role, select, owner {owner} admin {admin} other {member}} in {organization}
roleChanged.other: {name} is now {role, select, owner {owner} admin {admin} other {member}}

leaveDialog.title: Leave organization?
leaveDialog.description: You will lose access to {organization} and need someone there to add you back. Your account and your other memberships are unaffected.

removeDialog.title: Remove member?
removeDialog.description: {name} will lose access to {organization}. Their account and their other memberships are unaffected.

addPeople.title: Add people
addPeople.descriptionWithDirectory: Search for an account, or type an address nobody holds yet to invite it to {organization}.
addPeople.descriptionByAddress: Enter an email address exactly. It does not need an account on {organization} yet.
addPeople.mustInvite: An address without an account has nobody to add, so it can only be invited.

invited.many: {count, plural, one {# person was} other {# people were}} invited to {organization}

added.many: {count, plural, one {# person was} other {# people were}} added to {organization}

notes.undelivered: {count, number} could not be emailed, so send {count, plural, one {it} other {those}} again

enableDialog.title: Enable {name}?
enableDialog.description: {email} can sign in again, with every membership they had. Sessions and application tokens ended when the account was disabled stay ended.

disableDialog.title: Disable {name}?
disableDialog.description: {email} is signed out everywhere and cannot sign in again, to this instance or any application that uses it, until the account is enabled. Memberships are kept.
disableDialog.soleOwner: They are the only active owner of {organizations}. Nobody will be able to administer {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} until the account is enabled again.
disableDialog.reasonPlaceholder: Why this account is being disabled

memberships.title: Organizations
memberships.view: View the {count, plural, one {# organization} other {# organizations}} {name} belongs to

administrators.title: Administrators
administrators.view: View {count, plural, one {# administrator} other {# administrators}}

members.title: Members
members.view: View {count, plural, one {# member} other {# members}}

suspend.title: Suspend organization?
suspend.description: Nobody can sign in to {name} while it is suspended, not even its owners.

reactivate.title: Reactivate organization?
reactivate.description: {name} becomes active again and its members return.

delete.title: Delete organization?
delete.description: {name} disappears for everyone who belongs to it right away. You can restore it until the retention period is over, after which it is purged.

restore.title: Restore organization?
restore.description: {name} becomes active again and its members can sign in.

dangerZone.title: Danger zone
dangerZone.description: These changes are visible outside the organization or affect everyone in it.
dangerZone.deleteDescription: Deletion takes effect at once. You and everyone else lose access immediately, and only the instance administrators can bring the organization back before it is purged.

deleteDialog.title: Delete organization?
deleteDialog.description: {organization} disappears for you and for every one of its members right away. Only the instance administrators can restore it, and once the retention period is over it is purged.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: How this organization is named and presented to everyone who reaches it.

slug.description: The slug is how everyone reaches this organization. Changing it breaks every existing link, bookmark and invitation, and the old one stops working immediately.
slug.dialogDescription: {organization} currently lives at {path}. Every existing link, bookmark and invitation pointing at it stops working the moment you save, and there is no redirect.

branding.name: Name
branding.logoHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP, or SVG up to 2 MB
branding.backgroundImageHint: PNG, JPEG, or WebP up to 10 MB
branding.faviconHint: ICO, PNG, or SVG up to 1 MB

create.title: Create organization
create.description: Add a new organization and upload its branding.
create.handedToOwners: {name} was created and handed to its owners

authentication.title: Sign-in policy
authentication.description: Who can join {organization}, and how members prove it is them.

publicSignUp.title: Allow public sign-up
publicSignUp.description: Anyone who reaches {organization} can create an account and join as a member, without an invitation.
publicSignUp.ownersAndAdminsOnly: Only owners and admins can change this.

twoFactor.title: Require two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: Members without an authenticator app or a passkey must set one up before they can use {organization} or sign in to its applications.
twoFactor.setUpYourOwnFirst: Set up an authenticator app or a passkey on your own account first.
twoFactor.compliance: {compliant, number} of {total, number} active members have a second factor

confirmTwoFactor.title: Require two-factor authentication?
confirmTwoFactor.description: {count, plural, one {# active member has} other {# active members have}} no second factor. Until they set up an authenticator app or a passkey, they cannot use {organization} or sign in to its applications.
confirmTwoFactor.notice: They are asked to set one up the next time they sign in.

saved.twoFactorOptional: {organization} no longer requires a second factor

otherAccount.title: You are signed in as someone else
otherAccount.description: This invitation was sent to {email}, but you are signed in as {signedInAs}.

unknown.title: This invitation link is not valid
unknown.description: It may have been withdrawn, already used, or replaced by a newer invitation to the same address. Ask whoever invited you to send another one.

expired.title: This invitation has expired
expired.description: Invitations are only good for a limited time. Ask whoever invited you to send a new one.

organizationUnavailable.title: This organization is not accepting anyone right now
organizationUnavailable.description: It was suspended or scheduled for deletion after the invitation was sent.

alreadyMember.title: You already belong to this organization
alreadyMember.description: Sign in and carry on where you left off.

unconfirmedAddress.title: Confirm your email address first
unconfirmedAddress.description: Your invitation is waiting. Confirm your address, or open the invitation link we emailed you, and you can accept it.

join.title: Join {organization}
join.description: {organization} is open to anyone. You will join as {email}.

userPicker.searchPlaceholder: Search by name or email address...

validation.backgroundFile: Use a PNG, JPEG, or WebP up to 10 MB
validation.faviconFile: Use an ICO, PNG, or SVG up to 1 MB
